newsitem.title: UK: Forties to load 27.9 mln barrels in Dec, up from N.
newsitem.headline: Forties to load 27.9 mln barrels in Dec, up from N.

text.p: About 27.9 million barrels of North Sea crude oil Forties are scheduled to load in December, up from the 25.5 million barrels scheduled to load in November, traders said.

The December Forties programme will consist of 28 600,000 barrels cargoes, 18 500,000 barrel cargoes, one 530,000 barrel cargo and the usual 1.5 million barrels which will go directly to operator BP's Grangemouth refinery.
In November, the programme was made up of 19 cargoes of 600,000 barrels, 23 of 500,000 barrels, one each of 630,000 and 485,000 barrels and 1.5 million to Grangemouth.
The higher December programme did not surprise traders at Forties equity producers because of rising volumes from contributors Thelma, Telford and Fergus.
